title: lib
summary: Benilla's lib.rs is crate plumbing: module re-exports, AUTH_PORT/CLIENT_BUILD constants, host:port splitting, and the logon() orchestration (challenge -> SRP6 -> proof -> realm list). MSUI realizes the same flow through RealmClient.Logon with the same constants (build 5875, port from config); no independent wire contract beyond what protocol/auth already covers.

openItems.text: Ambiguous-B redial: Benilla redials the logon challenge (up to 8 times) when the server's SRP6 public key B is not width-stable (~1 in 137 dials), because those handshakes can fail proof verification despite a correct password; MSUI's RealmClient.Logon dials exactly once, so roughly 0.7% of logons can spuriously reject a correct password
